english.title: Remove soil / turf from the highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse, removed

(A)_[soil]_
(B)_[turf]_

from part of the highway at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 131(1)(b) and (3) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
removed soil / turf
from any part of the highway

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Section 131(1)(b) - may remove soil or turf for the purpose of improving the highway and with consent of the highway authority.
The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or excuse, removed

(A)_[soil]_
(B)_[turf]_

from part of the highway at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..).
